name: 27799-decodeheavy-opt125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine.
architecture: OPTForCausalLM dense decoder: 12 layers, 12 heads, hidden 768, ffn 3072, vocab 50272, max_position_embeddings 2048, float16.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 4096 requests / 3600 s safety, warmup the first 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 40 tokens and output exactly 2000 (min = max on both); 40 + 2000 + BOS is ~2041 against this checkpoint's 2048-token ceiling. The backend forces ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set, so every request generates exactly 2000 tokens. Every prompt is distinct synthetic English and shares no prefix with any other. `request_format: plain` is required: this tokenizer carries no chat template.
purpose: A long-form story generator writing 2000-token continuations from short unique prompts, 512 concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
# max-num-seqs and max-num-batched-tokens are pinned deliberately: the async engine path at this
# commit is in neither per-usage-context default table, so an unpinned run silently falls to
# max_num_seqs 128 and runs at a quarter of the declared width.

model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 2048
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
